severity_levels.P0: Critical — blocks release. Security vulnerability, data loss, or complete feature failure.
severity_levels.P1: High — blocks release. Major functionality broken, security weakness exploitable.
severity_levels.P2: Medium — should fix before release. Significant usability or quality issue.
severity_levels.P3: Low — fix if time permits. Minor visual, accessibility, or polish issue.
severity_levels.P4: Informational — document for future. No action required for release.

acceptance_thresholds.pose_pass: No rubric dimension below 4, mean ≥ 4.5, no unresolved anatomy/contact/renderer error
acceptance_thresholds.security_release_gate: No P0 or P1 issues remain
acceptance_thresholds.iteration_convergence: Iterations 9 and 10 must be consecutive quiet rounds with no new P0/P1, no new pose anatomy failure, no new broken control, no visual regression
